summary: The session lookup accepts a caller-controlled account identifier without an authorization check.

findings.title: Session lookup crosses the account boundary

evidence.trigger: An authenticated caller supplies another account identifier to the lookup function.

findings.risk: The caller can read a session that belongs to a different account.
findings.fix: Derive the account identifier from the authenticated principal and add a cross-account rejection test.

findings.title: The error path reports success after storage failure

evidence.trigger: The session store raises a write exception.

findings.risk: Callers receive a success state even though the session was not persisted.
findings.fix: Propagate a typed failure and assert that no success response is returned.

residual_assumptions.failure_mode: The storage client documents which write errors are safe to retry.
residual_assumptions.maintainer: The handler remains the single entry point for session creation.
residual_assumptions.trust_boundary: No downstream service independently re-authorizes the requested account.
